description_en: Creates an enterprise network-attached storage (NAS) drive (formerly Wuying CloudDisk)
description_zh: 创建企业网盘（原无影云盘）
name: CreateCloudDriveService

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the enterprise NAS drive
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The network type of the office network
parameters.name: office_site_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the office network. This parameter takes effect only when the network type is set to `AD_CONNECTOR`
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络ID，当办公网络类型为`AD_CONNECTOR`时有效
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) associated with the AD office network. This parameter takes effect only when `OfficeSiteType` is set to `AD_CONNECTOR`. If `OfficeSiteId` is specified, you do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 当`OfficeSiteType`为`AD_CONNECTOR`时，表示AD办公网络的云企业网实例ID。当`OfficeSiteId`不为空时，此值可不填写
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The domain controller name of the AD office network. This parameter takes effect only when `OfficeSiteType` is set to `AD_CONNECTOR`. If `OfficeSiteId` is specified, you do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 当`OfficeSiteType`为`AD_CONNECTOR`时，表示AD办公网络对应的域控名称。当`OfficeSiteId`不为空时，此值可不填写
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The maximum storage capacity of a personal drive when you assign a personal drive to a user. Unit: bytes
parameters.help_zh: 分配用户个人盘时，个人盘的存储峰值。单位：Byte（字节）
parameters.name: user_max_size

parameters.help_en:
The Peak Volume of the NAS drive storage space.

When you create a pay-as-you-go NAS drive, the unit is bytes.
When you create an upfront NAS drive, the unit is GiB. For example, to create a 500 GiB upfront NAS drive, set this parameter to 500. To create a 2 TiB upfront NAS drive, set this parameter to 2048
parameters.help_zh:
网盘存储空间最大峰值。

创建按量付费网盘时，单位为Byte（字节）。
创建预付费网盘时，单位为GiB。例如，如需创建500GiB的预付费网盘，则填写500；如需创建2TiB的预付费网盘，则填写2048
parameters.name: max_size

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.name: solution_id

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the NAS drive
parameters.name: cds_charge_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. This parameter takes effect and is optional only when CdsChargeType is set to `PrePaid`
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动续费。仅当付费类型为`PrePaid`时，该参数才生效且为可选参数
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration. The unit is specified by `PeriodUnit`. This parameter takes effect and is required only when `CdsChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`
parameters.help_zh: 购买资源的时长。单位由`PeriodUnit`指定。当参数`CdsChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效，且为必选值
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The unit of the subscription duration for the subscription NAS drive. This parameter takes effect and is required only when `CdsChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`
parameters.help_zh: 预付费网盘的购买时长单位。当参数`CdsChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效，且为必选值
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of users for the subscription NAS drive. This parameter takes effect and is required only when `CdsChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`
parameters.help_zh: 预付费网盘的用户数量限额。当参数`CdsChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效，且为必选值
parameters.name: user_count

parameters.help_en: The user ID for resource ownership in reseller pattern. You do not need to specify this parameter if you are not in reseller pattern
parameters.help_zh: 转售模式的资源归属用户ID，非转售模式无需填写该参数
parameters.name: reseller_owner_uid

CdsId.description_en: The ID of the enterprise NAS drive

CdsName.description_en: The service name of the cloud storage

CenId.description_en:
The instance ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN).

To connect to cloud desktops over a VPC, you can add the office network to a CEN instance. This CEN instance is the one to which the on-premises network is connected by using a VPN or Express Connect circuit
CenId.description_zh:
云企业网CEN实例ID。

如果想要通过VPC连接的方式接入云电脑，可以将办公网络加入到云企业网实例中。该云企业网实例为本地网络通过VPN或者专线接入的云企业网实例

ConflictCdsAndOrder.description_en: The existing NAS drive or NAS drive order that conflicts with the NAS drive to be created
ConflictCdsAndOrder.description_zh: 与当前要创建的网盘冲突的存量网盘或网盘订单

ConflictCds.description_en: The information about the conflicting NAS drive

ConflictOrder.description_en: The information about the conflicting unpaid NAS drive order (subscription NAS drive order)
ConflictOrder.description_zh: 冲突的未支付的网盘订单信息（预付费网盘的订单）

CdsId.description_en: The ID of the enterprise NAS drive. The order is not paid, and the NAS drive is unavailable
CdsId.description_zh: 企业网盘ID（订单尚未支付，网盘不可使用）

OrderId.description_en: The order ID. You can obtain the order ID on the Orders page in the Alibaba Cloud User Center
OrderId.description_zh: 订单ID。您可以在阿里云用户中心的订单管理页面获取

DomainName.description_zh: AD办公网络对应的AD域名称

MaxSize.description_zh: 企业网盘最大存储峰值。单位：Byte（字节）

OfficeSiteType.description_en: The network type of the office network

OrderId.description_zh: 订单ID。您可以在阿里云用户中心的订单管理页面获取
